structure.unit: Heat, Light, Power, Water and Other Utility Companies Generally

law.catch_line: Regulation of service by certain gas pipeline companies to municipalities
law.text: Notwithstanding any provision of law the Commission shall regulate, to the same extent as it regulates other public utilities, the utility service furnished to any municipal corporation by a natural gas pipeline transmission company, all of whose facilities are located within the Commonwealth, and the rates, charges and facilities of such company used to furnish such service.
